name: retained-export-gate
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.proof-emit.json > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/types.log" 2>&1; bun test research/bapa/retained-export.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/proof-symbolic-smoke.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/capture.log" 2>&1; SHA=$(tr -d '\n' < "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/symbolic-capture/capture-sha256.txt"); bun research/bapa/proof-emit.ts --capture "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/symbolic-capture/closure" --sha256 "$SHA" --out "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/project" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/emission.log" 2>&1; ROOT=$PWD; cd "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/project"; lake build > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/lean-build.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate/gate.ts" "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/lean-build.log" BapaProof.lean > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/axioms.log" 2>&1; printf '%s\n' 'feat(lean): emit retained BAPA certificates without search' > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commit-message.txt"; cd "$ROOT"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commit-message.txt" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commitlint.log" 2>&1
